golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é a diferença de prazo de recebimento e número máximo de parcelas entre o Parcelado Lojista e o Parcelado Emissor na Getnet?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
No **Parcelado Emissor**, você recebe o valor de uma só vez, entre **2 e 31 dias**, conforme o plano, e pode parcelar a venda em até **24 vezes**. No **Parcelado Lojista**, a primeira parcela é recebida em **D+31** e as seguintes a cada **30 dias**, com parcelamento de até **12 vezes**. Portanto, o Emissor permite até 12 parcelas a mais e paga o lojista de uma só vez, enquanto no Lojista os recebimentos são escalonados.

**Fonte:** https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: A resposta bate exatamente com a referência: Emissor recebe de uma vez entre 2 e 31 dias e permite até 24 parcelas; Lojista recebe a primeira em D+31 e as demais a cada 30 dias, em até 12 parcelas. Também responde diretamente à diferença pedida.

golden_repeat_items.question: On the Get Smart, how much does the monthly rental drop if I sell R$ 10,000 or R$ 30,000 a month, and do meal vouchers (VA/VR) or Crediário sales count toward waiving the rental?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
For the Get Smart, the published monthly rental is R$ 50 at monthly sales of R$ 10,000 and R$ 10 at R$ 30,000. Without meeting the minimum sales volume, it is R$ 129.90/month. VA/VR voucher and Crediário sales do not count toward waiving the rental.

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é o valor para comprar a Get Smart em definitivo e qual é a taxa cobrada no Pix nessa maquininha?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
A Getnet não publica o preço para comprar a Get Smart em definitivo nem a taxa Pix específica dessa maquininha. Ela informa que aceita Pix por QR Code na maquininha, mas não divulga a tarifa. Para uma cotação, confirme diretamente com a Getnet; não consegui confirmar um canal ou link específico para solicitá-la. Como alternativa, a página da Get Smart informa aluguel mensal de R$ 129,90 sem atingir o volume mínimo; os valores por faixa de vendas e a isenção têm limites divergentes entre páginas da Getnet, então confirme a condição aplicável com a empresa.

Fontes:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/
https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cuánto tengo que facturar al mes para quedar exento del alquiler de la Get Smart?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
La página específica de Get Smart indica que el alquiler queda exento desde R$ 60.000 de ventas al mes; no cuentan las ventas de VA/VR ni Crediário. Sin embargo, la página general de maquininhas muestra otros umbrales (R$ 40.000 o R$ 80.000), así que no se puede confirmar cuál aplica a tu comercio. Verifícalo en el simulador o directamente con Getnet.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference by giving the Get Smart-specific threshold of R$ 60.000/month, noting the conflicting R$ 40.000/R$ 80.000 figures, and advising confirmation with the simulator or Getnet. All factual claims are supported by the evidence, including that VA/VR and Crediário do not count.

golden_repeat_items.answer:
Agora, a maquininha Get Smart (ID POS-GS-99812) consta como **OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT**: a sessão de dados móveis travou. O estado do 4G é “Dual-SIM 4G session stalled” e a interface Wi‑Fi está desativada; não há horário de atualização disponível, então não consigo confirmar se esse estado ainda é o atual neste instante.

Como orientação de troubleshooting, tente reiniciar a maquininha e aguardar o indicador de rede. Se continuar sem conexão, o runbook recomenda conectar ao Wi‑Fi da loja, se disponível; depois, desligar, recolocar o chip SIM e ligar novamente; e executar o teste de comunicação (tecla de função, 60, opção 2 — manutenção, opção 1 — teste de comunicação). A instrução de recolocar o chip da FAQ é específica para chip Algar; a documentação consultada não informa como reativar a interface Wi‑Fi nem como diagnosticar especificamente o 4G Dual-SIM. Se continuar sem conexão após esses passos, peça aqui para eu encaminhar o caso a um especialista humano.

Sources: internal://support-runbook; https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/; https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Por qué canales puedo abrirla y cuál es el número de WhatsApp de Getnet?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Puedes abrir Get Conta eligiendo una maquininha u otro producto Getnet (maquininhas, Link de Pagamento o Get Tap) en el sitio, por WhatsApp o por teléfono. golden_repeat_items.question: Como devo instalar o chip Algar na maquininha da Getnet e qual é a cobertura dele?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Com a maquininha desligada, abra a tampa traseira, insira o chip no slot marcado SIM1 ou SIM2, com a face metálica voltada para baixo, feche a tampa e ligue o aparelho. Aguarde a conexão de dados; quando aparecer a rede 2G ou 3G, estará pronto. O modo de ligar/desligar varia conforme o modelo.

A Getnet descreve o chip Algar como mult operadora, com funcionamento em cobertura 2G/3G no Brasil e sem necessidade de trocar de chip. Porém, não encontrei mapa nem dados de cobertura por cidade ou endereço, então isso não garante sinal em todos os locais. Também não há modelos específicos ou tipo/tamanho de SIM informados na documentação; confirme que sua maquininha tem slot SIM1 ou SIM2.

Fontes: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The installation steps and the 2G/3G Brazil coverage claim match the reference, but the answer adds unsupported statements that there is no map or city/address coverage data and that no specific models or SIM type/size are informed. Those extra claims are not supported by the evidence, so groundedness and correctness are capped.

golden_repeat_items.question: En el Crediário de Getnet, ¿quién define la tasa de interés y aprueba la operación, dónde se visualizan los intereses y estas ventas cuentan para la exención del alquiler de la maquininha?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
En el Crediário, la tasa de interés y el plazo máximo de cuotas varían según el emisor de la tarjeta, que también aprueba la operación. Los intereses se muestran en la simulación realizada en la maquininha; no pude confirmar otro lugar donde consultarlos. Las ventas Crediário no cuentan para la exención del alquiler de la maquininha.

- https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/
- https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
- https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on all required points: the card issuer sets the rate and approves, interest is shown in the simulation on the card machine, and Crediário sales do not count toward the rental waiver. The cited URLs are also consistent with the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: What are common reasons a bank triggers a chargeback on Getnet, and what happens with card-not-present sales even if the merchant proves the transaction?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Common chargeback reasons include goods not received or defective, the cardholder not recognizing the transaction, duplicate processing, a refund not being processed, or the customer having paid by another method. Getnet describes a chargeback as the bank cancelling the transaction and debiting the merchant. For card-not-present sales, cancellation may still happen even if you prove the transaction. Getnet’s FAQ does not specify the dispute process, evidence requirements, deadlines, or appeal options.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

golden_repeat_items.question: A Get Conta oferece cartão virtual grátis e antecipação de recebíveis? Quais tipos de documento são aceitos no cadastro e em quais lojas de aplicativos o app Getnet Brasil está disponível?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Sim. A Get Conta oferece cartão virtual grátis e acesso à antecipação de recebíveis. O cadastro aceita CPF (pessoa física) ou CNPJ (empresa), e o app Getnet Brasil está disponível no Google Play e na App Store.

As informações públicas consultadas não detalham modalidades, taxas ou prazos da antecipação. Para conhecer as condições aplicáveis, simule no app ou no Portal Minha Conta.

Fontes:
- https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/
- https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é o faturamento mensal mínimo necessário para ter isenção do aluguel da maquininha Get Clássica?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
As páginas oficiais divergem: a página da Get Clássica informa faturamento de R$ 10.000 por mês para isenção, enquanto a página de todas as maquininhas informa R$ 20.000. Ambas indicam aluguel de R$ 79,90/mês se o mínimo não for atingido. Vendas de Voucher (VA/VR) e Crediário não contam para a isenção, conforme a página específica do produto. Para confirmar qual limite se aplica à sua contratação, consulte o simulador ou a Getnet.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the evidence and reference: it states the conflicting thresholds (R$ 10.000 vs R$ 20.000), notes the rental amount, and advises confirming with the simulator or Getnet. It also correctly mentions that Voucher and Crediário sales do not count, which is supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é a razão social e o banco (nome, código e final da conta) cadastrados no meu perfil, e quais são as taxas de crédito parcelado em 6x e 9x na Get Clássica?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
A razão social cadastrada é **Bistrô Moinhos de Vento S.A.**. No perfil consta **Banco Itaú**, código **341**, conta com final **04-2**.

Na Get Clássica, as taxas publicadas “a partir de” para crédito parcelado são **9,94% em 6x** e **11,41% em 9x**.

Fonte das taxas: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

judge.rationale: A resposta traz exatamente a razão social e os dados bancários do perfil, além das taxas corretas de 6x e 9x na Get Clássica. Tudo está समर्थado pela evidência fornecida e responde diretamente ao que foi perguntado.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cuánto puede variar el plazo para recibir una venta hecha con ese medio, y cuántas claves permite para personas físicas y para empresas?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
El plazo para recibir una venta por Pix puede variar hasta un día corrido, según el modelo de Pix para el que seas elegible y la hora en que se apruebe la venta; aunque Getnet lo promociona como recepción «en segundos», no hay un plazo único. Se permiten hasta 5 claves Pix por cuenta para personas físicas y hasta 20 por cuenta para empresas.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

judge.rationale: La respuesta coincide con la referencia: indica que el plazo puede variar hasta un día corrido y que hay hasta 5 claves para personas físicas y 20 para empresas. Todo está respaldado por la evidencia de la página de Pix de Getnet.

golden_repeat_items.answer: O diagnóstico do terminal Get Smart identificou dessincronização das chaves do PIN-pad (`POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN`), associada à recusa da transação de R$ 430,00 (TX-88410). A reprogramação remota da chave foi aprovada. A ordem de serviço **SO-9858A6D5** foi criada e está na fila para execução, prevista para ocorrer em até 2 horas; o serviço ainda não foi realizado.

judge.rationale: The answer matches the approved remote PIN-pad re-keying and the scheduled service order within 2 hours, which is exactly what the reference states. All claims are supported by the evidence, including that the work is queued and not yet performed.

golden_repeat_items.question: For the Get Clássica card machine, what are the published installment credit rates for 4x, 7x, and 10x, and do those rates apply if I am already a Getnet customer?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The published Get Clássica installment-credit rates are **4x: 8.96%**, **7x: 10.43%**, and **10x: 11.90%**. These are starting-from, single rates for Mastercard, Visa, Elo, and Amex. They are an offer for new customers (individuals, MEIs, and companies with annual revenue up to R$3 million), subject to registration analysis, so they are not published as applying to existing Getnet customers. If you already use Getnet, simulate your rates in the Getnet app.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly on the three published installment rates and correctly states that the offer is for new customers only, with existing Getnet customers directed to simulate in the app. All claims are supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: En el Link de Pagamento de Getnet, ¿cuánto cuesta al mes el plan Básico, cuántas transacciones con tarjeta incluye, cuánto cobra por transacción extra y se puede incluir el envío (frete) en el cobro?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
El plan Básico cuesta R$ 28 al mes e incluye 60 transacciones con tarjeta mensuales. Cada transacción adicional cuesta R$ 0,50. Sí, puedes incluir el envío (frete) en el cobro al completar los datos del producto y del frete al crear el enlace.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: R$ 28/month, 60 card transactions included, R$ 0.50 per extra transaction, and freight can be included in the charge. Every claim is supported by the provided evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: What does the Getnet FAQ recommend for charging the Get Smart battery (when to charge, for how long, and what to avoid), and what are the different ways to power a Getnet card machine on or off?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The Getnet FAQ recommends charging the Get Smart when the battery reaches 20%, for at least 3 continuous hours, and avoiding letting it discharge completely.

For powering a Getnet card machine on or off, the method depends on the model. The FAQ lists the green key, the up-arrow key, the plug, or holding the green/red key for 5 seconds. It does not map these methods to specific models or say which applies to powering on versus off, so check the instructions for your model.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the evidence on the Get Smart charging advice: 20%, at least 3 continuous hours, and do not fully discharge. It also correctly lists the model-dependent power methods from the FAQ and notes that the source does not map them to specific models or on/off actions.

golden_repeat_items.question: Quando eu escolho receber pela Get Conta, em quanto tempo e em qual período do dia o pagamento cai? Além disso, quais são os canais de autoatendimento da Getnet e qual é o horário de atendimento ao cliente?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Ao escolher receber pela Get Conta, o pagamento cai em até 2 dias úteis, no período da manhã. Os canais de autoatendimento são o Portal Minha Conta e o aplicativo Getnet Brasil. O atendimento ao cliente funciona das 06h às 22h; a fonte não especifica os dias da semana nem o fuso horário desse horário.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: up to 2 business days, in the morning, self-service via Portal Minha Conta and the Getnet Brasil app, and customer service from 06h to 22h. It also adds a grounded caveat that the source does not specify the weekday coverage or time zone.

golden_repeat_items.question: With Getnet Crediário, who decides the maximum installment term and interest rate and approves the sale, how does the merchant get paid (timing and whether it arrives in a single lump sum), and do Crediário sales count toward the card machine rental waiver?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
With Getnet Crediário, the card issuer determines the maximum installment term and interest rate and approves the sale. A sale can be split into up to 48 installments; the card-machine simulation shows the interest. You receive payment within up to 2 business days after capture, as a single payment regardless of the number of installments, net of the discount rate. Crediário sales do not count toward the card-machine rental waiver.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/ ; https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on all requested points: the card issuer sets the term and interest and approves the sale, payment arrives in up to 2 business days as a single lump sum net of the discount rate, and Crediário sales do not count toward the rental waiver. golden_repeat_items.answer:
Na Get Smart, o Modo Quiosque mantém a tela sempre ligada, executa um aplicativo por vez e é protegido por senha; é indicado para totens de autoatendimento.

O split físico para empresas inclui os módulos de comissão e gorjeta. A divisão do valor ocorre no momento da transação.

golden_repeat_items.question: Primero, ¿cuánto vendí ayer por Pix en mi cuenta, en qué ciclo se acreditó y en qué banco y cuenta terminada se deposita? Segundo, ¿el Link de Pagamento de Getnet incluye antifraude, permite vender a extranjeros con RNE y poner varios productos en un mismo carrito?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Ayer, 18 de noviembre, vendiste **R$ 410,00 por Pix** (netos: **R$ 410,00**). Se acreditó en el ciclo **D+0**, de forma instantánea; figura como liquidado. El depósito se realiza en **Banco Itaú (341)**, cuenta terminada en **04-2**.

El **Link de Pagamento** incluye antifraude, permite ventas a extranjeros con documento **RNE** y admite varios productos en un mismo carrito. La información pública no especifica condiciones adicionales para usar RNE ni un límite de productos por carrito.

Para crear el enlace puedes usar Portal Minha Conta o la app Getnet Brasil. **Fuente:** https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on the Pix amount, D+0 instant settlement, and deposit bank/account, and it correctly states the three Getnet Link de Pagamento features. All claims are supported by the evidence, including the note that extra conditions/max products are not specified.

golden_repeat_items.question: And how do I install it in the card machine?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
To install the Algar chip:
1. Turn the card machine off. The power-off method varies by model (it may use the green key, up-arrow key, plug, or holding the green/red keys for 5 seconds).
2. Open the back cover and insert the chip into the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2, with the metal side facing down.
3. Close the cover and turn the machine on. Wait for the data connection; when the 2G or 3G indicator appears, it is ready.

To check the connection, press the function key (F, #, or another key depending on the model), then 60 → option 2 (maintenance) → option 1 (communication test).

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the official installation steps in the evidence: power off, open the back cover, insert the SIM1/SIM2 chip metal side down, close, power on, and wait for 2G/3G. The added communication-test step is also supported by the evidence.

¿Y cómo cancelo en esa misma maquininha una venta de días anteriores?
En la Get Smart, la segunda venta idéntica (misma tarjeta, marca y monto) dentro de 5 minutos se cancela automáticamente. Espera 5 minutos antes de intentarlo de nuevo o usa un monto diferente.

golden_repeat_items.question: Mi maquininha rechazó una venta hace poco y sigue dando error. ¿Pueden revisar qué pasó con esa transacción rechazada y solicitar la corrección técnica necesaria?
golden_repeat_items.answer: La venta TX-88410 por R$ 430,00 fue rechazada con ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE / POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN. El primer código indica un rechazo del emisor; junto con POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN, el diagnóstico señala que las claves del PIN-pad están desincronizadas. Esa corrección no puede hacerla el comercio. Un especialista aprobó el reingreso remoto de la clave para la maquininha POS-GS-99812: se creó la orden de servicio SO-84D5E727 y el trabajo quedó programado para dentro de 2 horas de hoy; todavía no se ha realizado. Mientras tanto, la guía interna indica que puedes seguir vendiendo con Pix o Link de Pagamento. Estos códigos y pasos provienen de una guía interna de soporte, no de una política pública de Getnet. Sources: internal://support-runbook; https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference: it says the human specialist approved the remote PIN-pad re-keying for POS-GS-99812, a service order was created, and execution is scheduled within 2 hours today. Its additional note about the internal guide is supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Get Clássica is the more basic POS machine. Get Smart adds a 5-in-1 device—a payment terminal, barcode reader, camera, fiscal-receipt printer and integrated management system—plus GetStore apps, Kiosk mode, POS TEF Digital integration and transaction-time split payments. Both are listed with 3G and Wi‑Fi; the published information does not confirm a difference in accepted cards or payment methods.

Published rental prices are R$ 79.90/month for Get Clássica and R$ 129.90/month for Get Smart when the minimum sales volume is not met. The published pages conflict on the monthly-sales threshold for waiving rent: for Get Clássica, one page says R$ 10,000 and another says R$ 20,000; for Get Smart, its individual page says R$ 60,000, while the lineup page gives R$ 40,000 or R$ 80,000. Getnet advises confirming the applicable threshold in its simulator or with Getnet.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/ and https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/ and https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer accurately distinguishes the feature set and rental prices, and its claims are supported by the evidence. However, it omits the reference fact that both models have the same published card rates, so it is not fully correct for the asked comparison.

golden_repeat_items.question: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Your Get Smart is showing **OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT**, meaning its mobile-data session has stalled. Try these steps in order:

1. Restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator.
2. If Wi‑Fi is available, connect it to your store Wi‑Fi.
3. Turn the terminal off, reseat the SIM chip, then turn it back on.
4. Run a communication test: press the function key (F, #, or another key depending on the model), press **60**, choose **2 (maintenance)**, then **1 (communication test)**.

The diagnostics also show Wi‑Fi as disabled; the available guidance does not specify a separate procedure to enable it. These troubleshooting steps are internal guidance, not published Getnet policy. If the machine remains offline on both mobile data and Wi‑Fi after trying them, ask me to hand this case to a human specialist for help with a chip or terminal swap.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/; https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference troubleshooting sequence for OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT, including restart, Wi‑Fi, SIM reseat, communication test, and escalation to a human specialist for a chip or terminal swap. Its claims are supported by the evidence, including the internal runbook and the FAQ steps.

golden_repeat_items.question: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet confirms that receivables advance is available as a feature of Get Conta, which is managed in the Getnet Brasil app. However, its public text does not explain the advance mechanics, how to request it, eligibility, payout timing, or the advance-specific rate. To check whether it’s available to you and see your terms, simulate it in the Getnet app or Portal Minha Conta, or confirm with Getnet support. The regular settlement-plan rates published in the FAQ are not identified as advance rates.

https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/
https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/
https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the evidence that Get Conta includes receivables advance, that the public page is video-only, and that users must simulate in the app/Portal Minha Conta or contact support for terms. It avoids inventing mechanics or rates and stays on point.

golden_repeat_items.question: My card machine is showing a transaction decline error.
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The recorded decline is `ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE / POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN`: the terminal’s PIN-pad cryptographic keys are out of sync and require a remote re-key or terminal swap. The remote re-key was approved and scheduled for today; service order `SO-0AF3ED0C` has been created and queued, but the work has not yet been performed. Until it is resolved, the internal troubleshooting guidance says you can continue taking sales with Pix or a Payment Link.

Sources: internal://support-runbook

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on the decline code, the PIN-pad key desynchronization, and that a remote re-key was approved and scheduled with a service order created. It is supported by the evidence, which explicitly states the same code/meaning and that the re-key was scheduled; the extra Pix/Payment Link guidance is also grounded in the runbook.

golden_repeat_items.question: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
With Getnet crediário, you can split a sale into up to 48 installments. The maximum term and interest rate vary by card issuer; the card-machine simulation shows the interest, and the issuer approves the transaction.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/

judge.rationale: The answer exactly states the supported limit of up to 48 installments and correctly notes that term and interest vary by card issuer. This is directly supported by the evidence and fully answers the merchant's question.

golden_repeat_items.question: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Yes. Getnet Payment Link is designed for selling through WhatsApp or social networks, without a card machine. Create a link in Portal Minha Conta, or in the Getnet Brasil app under Produtos e Serviços > Link de Pagamento > Criar Link de Pagamento. Add the product details and payment options, then share or copy the link to your customer in WhatsApp.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference: Payment Link is intended for WhatsApp/social network sales without a card machine, and the merchant creates and shares the link. All claims are supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: When will the money from yesterday's sales be deposited?
golden_repeat_items.answer: There isn’t one public deposit date for yesterday’s sales: it depends on the payment type and your account’s settlement plan. Public terms include up to 2 business days for some options, but they don’t let me determine your specific deposit date. You’ll need to sign in to the Getnet Brasil app or Portal Minha Conta to see your account’s schedule. Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer correctly says there is no single public deposit date, that it depends on the payment type/account settlement plan, and that the user must sign in to see the schedule. This matches the evidence that the specific schedule is account-specific and only public terms are generic settlement windows.

golden_repeat_items.question: It is still offline after I restarted it. What else can I try?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Since restarting did not help, try these next steps in order:

1. If available, connect the terminal to your store’s Wi‑Fi.
2. If it is still offline, turn it off, reseat the SIM, then turn it back on and wait for the network indicator.
3. Run the communication test: press the function key (F, #, or the model’s equivalent), then 60 → option 2 (maintenance) → option 1 (communication test).

Your terminal is reporting OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT, meaning its mobile-data session stalled. The available guidance does not specify how to enable a disabled Wi‑Fi interface or recover a stalled 4G session. If it remains offline on both mobile data and Wi‑Fi after these steps, ask me to hand the case to a human specialist for a possible chip or terminal swap.

judge_input.conversation:
merchant: My card machine won't connect to the internet.
assistant: Your Get Smart is offline: the recorded status, OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT, means its mobile-data session stalled. Try these steps in order (internal troubleshooting guidance, not published Getnet policy):

1. Restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator.
2. If Wi‑Fi is available, connect it to your store’s Wi‑Fi.
3. Turn it off, reseat the SIM chip, then turn it back on.
4. Run the communication test: press the function key (F, #, or another key depending on the model), enter 60, choose 2 (maintenance), then 1 (communication test).

If it remains offline on both mobile data and Wi‑Fi after these steps, ask to have a ticket opened with a human specialist for a possible chip or terminal swap. I can hand this to a human specialist in this conversation if the steps do not work.

Getnet’s FAQ provides the communication-test sequence, but does not publish a general guide for machines that will not connect.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

My card machine won't connect to the internet.
It is still offline after I restarted it. What else can I try?
Your Get Smart is offline: the recorded status, OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT, means its mobile-data session stalled. Try these steps in order (internal troubleshooting guidance, not published Getnet policy):

1. Restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator.
2. If Wi‑Fi is available, connect it to your store’s Wi‑Fi.
3. Turn it off, reseat the SIM chip, then turn it back on.
4. Run the communication test: press the function key (F, #, or another key depending on the model), enter 60, choose 2 (maintenance), then 1 (communication test).

If it remains offline on both mobile data and Wi‑Fi after these steps, ask to have a ticket opened with a human specialist for a possible chip or terminal swap. I can hand this to a human specialist in this conversation if the steps do not work.

Getnet’s FAQ provides the communication-test sequence, but does not publish a general guide for machines that will not connect.

golden_repeat_items.question: My card machine is showing a transaction decline error.
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The human specialist did not approve the terminal re-key or swap yet and asked that the buyer first try a different card. Your Get Smart recorded decline code is ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE / POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN. Please ask the buyer to try another card; if the issue persists, the terminal’s PIN-pad keys are out of sync and a remote re-key or terminal swap would need L2 approval. Until then, you can accept Pix or use a Payment Link.

The public FAQ does not confirm the cause or specific fix for this error. Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/ (The troubleshooting guidance above comes from the internal support runbook.)

judge.rationale: The answer matches the decisive outcome: the re-key/swap was not approved and the buyer should try a different card first. Its added notes about PIN-pad desync, Pix, and Payment Link are supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é o aluguel mensal da Get Smart?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
O aluguel da Get Smart é **R$ 129,90 por mês** quando o volume mínimo de vendas não é atingido. A página específica informa aluguel de R$ 50,00 a partir de R$ 10 mil em vendas mensais, R$ 10,00 a partir de R$ 30 mil e isenção a partir de R$ 60 mil; vendas de VA/VR e Crediário não contam para a isenção. Há divergência entre páginas oficiais quanto ao limite de isenção, então confirme o aplicável no simulador ou com a Getnet.

Fontes: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/ e https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly on the monthly rental and the tiered conditions, including the note about VA/VR and Crediário and the source URLs. All claims are supported by the evidence, which explicitly states these prices, thresholds, and the page disagreement.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cuántas cuotas permite el crediário de Getnet?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
El Crediário de Getnet permite dividir una venta en hasta 48 cuotas. El plazo máximo y los intereses dependen del emisor de la tarjeta; la simulación en la terminal muestra los intereses y el emisor aprueba la operación.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/

judge.rationale: La respuesta coincide exactamente con la referencia: indica hasta 48 cuotas y la salvedad de que el plazo máximo e intereses dependen del emisor. Además, la fuente citada está respaldada por la evidencia.

- **Inicial:** no monthly fee; **R$ 1.00 per paid link**, charged only when the payment is approved.
- **Básico:** **R$ 28 per month**, including 60 card transactions per month; each additional card transaction costs **R$ 0.50**.

The page’s simulator also shows a single **1.90% rate for Mastercard and Visa**, but it does not clarify how that rate applies by plan, payment method, or other transaction conditions. Check the simulator for the rate applicable to your sale.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: The answer correctly names both plans and their costs, matching the reference exactly. Its added note about the 1.90% simulator rate is supported by the evidence and does not change the core answer.

golden_repeat_items.question: What is the debit rate on the Get Clássica?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The published debit rate for Get Clássica is **from 1.69%**. This single rate applies to Mastercard, Visa, Elo, and Amex. The offer is for new customers who are individuals, MEIs, or companies with annual revenue up to R$3 million, and is subject to registration analysis. Existing Getnet customers should simulate their rate in the Getnet app.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly on the debit rate, and the added qualifications and source URL are supported by the evidence. It directly answers the merchant’s question with the published rate and relevant conditions.

golden_repeat_items.question: How many Pix keys can a company have?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
A company can register up to 20 Pix keys per account, according to Getnet’s published FAQ. I could not confirm whether that is also the nationwide regulatory limit.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: companies can have up to 20 Pix keys per account, with the individual/company distinction implicit in the cited FAQ. The limitation and source are supported by the evidence, and the note about not confirming the nationwide regulatory limit is also grounded.

golden_repeat_items.question: What is the Getnet support phone number for capitals and what are the service hours?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
For callers in capitals and metropolitan regions, Getnet lists **4002-4000** or **4003-4000**. Customer service hours are **06:00–22:00**; the published information does not specify which days those hours apply.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: 4002-4000 or 4003-4000 for capitals/metropolitan regions and service hours 06h to 22h. The added note about unspecified days is also supported by the evidence.

The Get Smart page shows two different “from” rates for credit in one payment: 3.69% and 3.79%, and does not clarify which applies. These rates are listed for sales received in Get Conta; please confirm the applicable rate with Getnet before relying on either figure.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference by stating the page is inconsistent and gives both 3.69% and 3.79% without clarifying which applies. It also correctly notes the Get Conta qualifier and advises confirming with Getnet, all supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: What is a chargeback?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
A chargeback (contestação de venda) is when the bank cancels a transaction and debits the merchant. It can happen, for example, if goods were not received or were defective, the cardholder does not recognize the transaction, the sale was processed twice, a refund was not processed, or the customer paid another way. Getnet also notes that card-not-present sales may be cancelled even when the merchant can prove the transaction.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference: it defines chargeback as the bank canceling a transaction and debiting the merchant, and includes the listed examples. Every factual claim is supported by the evidence from Getnet’s FAQ.

golden_repeat_items.question: On the Get Smart, why would a second identical sale be cancelled automatically?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
On a Get Smart, if two sales use the same card, card brand, and amount within 5 minutes, the second is automatically cancelled. The FAQ recommends waiting 5 minutes before retrying or using a different amount. It does not explain the technical mechanism or list other matching criteria.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the documented rule: identical sales with the same card, brand, and amount within 5 minutes trigger automatic cancellation of the second sale. It also gives the correct merchant guidance to wait 5 minutes or use a different amount.

golden_repeat_items.question: How long do I have to confirm a pre-authorization?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
You have up to 30 days to confirm a pre-authorization. The amount can be changed up to 4 times. The FAQ does not specify additional conditions or whether the deadline varies by transaction type.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer exactly matches the reference: 30 days to confirm and the amount can be changed up to 4 times. It also adds a grounded note that no extra conditions or transaction-type variations are specified.

golden_repeat_items.question: And from what monthly sales volume is that rental waived?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet’s published pages currently disagree: the Get Clássica page says the rental is waived from R$10,000 in monthly sales, while the all-machines page says R$20,000. VA/VR and Crediário sales do not count toward the threshold. Please confirm the applicable amount in Getnet’s simulator or with Getnet before relying on either figure.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/; https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer directly addresses the waiver threshold question and matches the reference’s conflict between R$10,000 and R$20,000, including the instruction to confirm in the simulator or with Getnet. Its claims are supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cómo creo un Link de Pago?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Puedes crear el Link de Pago iniciando sesión en Portal Minha Conta o en la app Getnet Brasil. En la app, ve a **Produtos e Serviços > Link de Pagamento > Criar Link de Pagamento**. Completa los datos del producto, el envío y las opciones de pago; luego copia o comparte el enlace con tu cliente. Puedes incluir varios productos en un mismo carrito, personalizar el enlace con una imagen del producto e incluir el envío en el cobro. La fuente no detalla la ruta exacta dentro del portal.

Fuente: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

golden_repeat_items.question: What is the Getnet ombudsman phone number and when is it open?

golden_repeat_items.question: Em quanto tempo recebo uma venda no Pix?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Na Getnet, o recebimento de uma venda no Pix pode acontecer “em segundos”, mas não há um prazo único garantido: pode variar em até 1 dia corrido, conforme o modelo de Pix para o qual você está elegível e o horário de aprovação da venda. Mantenha seus dados cadastrais atualizados. A página não detalha os critérios de elegibilidade nem horários de corte.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

judge.rationale: A resposta corresponde ao referência: diz que não há prazo único, que pode variar em até um dia corrido conforme o modelo elegível e o horário de aprovação, e que o site anuncia recebimento em segundos. Também acrescenta a orientação de manter os dados atualizados, tudo suportado pela evidência.

golden_repeat_items.question: Como faço o teste de comunicação na maquininha?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Pressione a tecla de função (F, # ou outra, conforme o modelo), digite **60**, selecione **2 (manutenção)** e, em seguida, **1 (teste de comunicação)**. A tecla de função pode variar conforme a maquininha.

Fontes: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: A resposta reproduz exatamente os passos documentados na evidência: tecla de função variável, digitar 60, opção 2 (manutenção) e opção 1 (teste de comunicação). Também cita a fonte aplicável.

golden_repeat_items.question: Minha maquininha está online?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Não. Sua maquininha Get Smart está offline (status `OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT`); o diagnóstico indica que a sessão de dados móveis travou e que o Wi‑Fi está desabilitado.

Como orientação de solução, tente nesta ordem: reinicie a maquininha e aguarde o indicador de rede; se houver Wi‑Fi disponível, conecte-a à rede da loja; desligue-a, recoloque o SIM e ligue novamente; depois execute o teste de comunicação: pressione a tecla de função (F, # ou outra, conforme o modelo), 60, opção 2 (manutenção) e opção 1 (teste de comunicação). Se continuar offline tanto no móvel quanto no Wi‑Fi após esses passos, peça para abrir um chamado com um especialista para avaliar a troca do chip ou do terminal. Se esses passos não resolverem, posso encaminhar o caso a um especialista humano nesta conversa se você pedir.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/ ; https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/ ; internal://support-runbook

judge.rationale: A resposta diz corretamente que a maquininha está offline e repete o status OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT, alinhado ao diagnóstico. Também inclui os passos de solução documentados e o modelo Get Smart; a única leve distração é a oferta adicional de encaminhar para humano, mas isso não contradiz o evidenciado.

golden_repeat_items.question: What is my terminal's connectivity status right now, and how long should I charge the Get Smart battery?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Your Get Smart terminal is **OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT**. Its mobile-data session has stalled; the diagnostics also report a stalled dual-SIM 4G session and a disabled Wi-Fi interface.

Troubleshooting guidance: restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator. If Wi-Fi is available, connect to the store Wi-Fi. If it remains offline, turn the terminal off, reseat the SIM, and power it back on. Then run the communication test: press the function key (F, #, or another key depending on the model), press 60, choose 2 (maintenance), then 1 (communication test). These recovery steps are from an internal troubleshooting runbook, not published Getnet policy. If it is still offline on both mobile data and Wi-Fi after those steps, ask for a human specialist to open a ticket for a chip or terminal swap.

Charge the Get Smart battery for **at least 3 hours continuously**; charge it when it reaches 20% and do not let it fully discharge. The published FAQ does not specify a more exact full-charge duration.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/ ; internal://support-runbook

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: it identifies the terminal as OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT and gives the battery guidance of at least 3 hours continuously, at 20%, and not fully discharging. All claims are supported by the evidence, including the internal diagnostics and published FAQ.

golden_repeat_items.question: Preciso já ter um produto Getnet para abrir?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Não. Você não precisa já ter um produto Getnet para abrir o Get Conta. O cadastro usa CPF, para pessoa física, ou CNPJ, para empresa; a abertura é feita escolhendo um produto Getnet, como maquininha, Link de Pagamento ou Get Tap. A página não especifica outros requisitos de elegibilidade.

Fonte: https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/

judge.rationale: A resposta diz corretamente que não é necessário já ter um produto Getnet e menciona CPF/CNPJ e os canais/produtos de abertura. Isso coincide com a evidência, que também indica que a página não especifica outros requisitos.

Preciso já ter um produto Getnet para abrir?
O Get Conta é a conta digital da Getnet. Com ela, você pode receber pagamentos na própria conta, acompanhar a operação, usar um cartão virtual gratuito e acessar antecipação de recebíveis. golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é o preço de compra da Get Clássica?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
A Getnet não publica o preço de compra da Get Clássica. O valor divulgado é de aluguel: R$ 79,90 por mês se o volume mínimo de vendas não for atingido. As páginas oficiais divergem sobre a isenção do aluguel: uma informa vendas de R$ 10 mil/mês e outra, R$ 20 mil/mês. Confirme o limite aplicável no simulador ou com a Getnet. Vendas de VA/VR e Crediário não contam para a isenção, conforme a página específica do produto.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: it says no purchase price is published and gives the published rental price of R$ 79,90, plus the noted waiver-threshold discrepancy and VA/VR/Crediário exclusion. All claims are supported by the evidence.

The offer is for eligible new customers, subject to registration analysis; existing Getnet customers should simulate their rates in the Getnet app.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly on the two published rates: 8.47% for 3x and 12.88% for 12x on Get Clássica. It is also supported by the evidence and includes the applicable context and source URL.

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é a diferença de prazo de recebimento e número máximo de parcelas entre o Parcelado Lojista e o Parcelado Emissor na Getnet?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
- **Parcelado Lojista:** você recebe a primeira parcela em **D+31** e as demais a cada **30 dias**; até **12 parcelas**.
- **Parcelado Emissor:** recebe o valor **de uma só vez**, entre **2 e 31 dias**, conforme o plano; até **24 parcelas**. A FAQ não especifica qual plano corresponde a cada prazo, então não há um prazo único confirmado para essa modalidade.

Fonte: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: A resposta coincide com a referência: Lojista tem primeira parcela em D+31 e até 12 parcelas; Emissor recebe de uma vez entre 2 e 31 dias e até 24 parcelas. Também inclui a observação correta de que a FAQ não detalha o plano exato do Emissor.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿De qué maneras permite Getnet cobrar con Pix y en qué soluciones está disponible?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet permite cobrar con Pix de cuatro maneras: por aproximación, por biometría (indicada como novedad), con Get Tap desde el teléfono y mediante código QR en la maquininha. Está disponible en maquininhas, link de pagamento, Get Tap, e-commerce y TEF.

El sitio no detalla los requisitos ni el proceso de activación por modalidad, y tampoco publica las tarifas de Pix. Recomienda mantener actualizados los datos de registro. Fuentes: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly on the four Pix methods and the five supported solutions. Its added note about missing requirements, activation details, and fees is supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: Does the Get Smart have a kiosk mode for self-service totems, and can it integrate with store checkout automation via TEF?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Yes. Get Smart supports Kiosk mode for self-service totems: it allows one app at a time, keeps the screen on, and is password protected. It also supports POS TEF Digital, described as integrating with checkout automation. The published information does not specify technical compatibility requirements, compatible checkout systems, or other limitations. It also says up to five devices can be used in one store.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: it confirms kiosk mode for self-service totems and POS TEF Digital integration. All added details are supported by the evidence, including the lack of specified compatibility requirements and the five-device limit.

golden_repeat_items.question: Who is eligible for the Get Clássica offer (customer types and annual revenue cap), and how fast do prepaid card sales settle?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Get Clássica is available to new individual customers (pessoa física), MEIs, and companies with annual revenue of up to R$ 3 million, subject to registration analysis. Prepaid card sales settle in up to 2 business days for credit and up to 1 business day for debit.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly on eligibility and revenue cap, and it gives the prepaid settlement times as stated in the evidence. It is directly responsive and actionable, with a supporting source URL.

golden_repeat_items.question: On the Get Smart, how much does the monthly rental drop if I sell R$ 10,000 or R$ 30,000 a month, and do meal vouchers (VA/VR) or Crediário sales count toward waiving the rental?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
At monthly sales of R$10,000, the Get Smart rental is R$50.00, down R$79.90 from the standard R$129.90. At R$30,000, it is R$10.00, down R$119.90. VA/VR voucher and Crediário sales do not count toward the rental waiver.

The Get Smart product page says rental is free at R$60,000/month, but Getnet’s general card-machine page lists different waiver thresholds (R$40,000 or R$80,000/month). The pages conflict, so confirm the applicable free-rental threshold with Getnet or in the simulator.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/; https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly on the rental amounts at R$10,000 and R$30,000 and correctly states that VA/VR and Crediário do not count. It is fully supported by the evidence and directly answers the merchant’s question.

golden_repeat_items.question: With Getnet's Payment Link, can I sell to foreign customers, put multiple items with shipping in one cart, and when does D+2 settlement become available?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Yes. Getnet’s Payment Link can support sales to foreign customers who have an RNE identification document; the published guidance does not confirm eligibility for every foreign customer or international card. The page does not state a standard settlement deadline for Payment Link.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on all asked points: foreign customers with RNE, multiple items plus shipping in one cart, and D+2 after 6 months subject to analysis. golden_repeat_items.question: Do I need to have a website to use Getnet's Payment Link, and what is the standard payout deadline for Payment Link sales during the first 6 months?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
A website is not indicated as a requirement: Getnet describes Payment Link as a way to sell through WhatsApp or social media, but its published page does not explicitly say a website is unnecessary.

Getnet does not publish a standard payout deadline for Payment Link sales during the first six months. It says D+2 settlement becomes available after six months of use, subject to analysis; that does not confirm the payout timing before then. golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é o valor para comprar a Get Smart em definitivo e qual é a taxa cobrada no Pix nessa maquininha?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
As fontes públicas não informam o preço para comprar a Get Smart em definitivo nem a taxa específica do Pix nessa maquininha. O FAQ orienta selecionar a opção débito para pagar por QR Code, mas isso não confirma que a taxa de débito seja a taxa do Pix. Para referência, a página da Get Smart publica aluguel de R$ 129,90 por mês sem atingir o volume mínimo; há divergência entre as páginas sobre a faixa de vendas que zera o aluguel, então confirme as condições diretamente com a Getnet.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/
https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: A resposta diz corretamente que não há preço público de compra definitiva nem taxa específica de Pix para a Get Smart, e também menciona o aluguel publicado e a divergência entre páginas. Isso é suportado pela evidência, incluindo o FAQ sobre QR Code no débito e a ausência de taxa Pix publicada.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cuánto tengo que facturar al mes para quedar exento del alquiler de la Get Smart?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Las páginas oficiales de Getnet se contradicen sobre el umbral exacto: la página de Get Smart indica que queda sin alquiler desde R$ 60.000 al mes; entre R$ 10.000 y R$ 29.999 el alquiler sería R$ 50, y entre R$ 30.000 y R$ 59.999, R$ 10. La página general de maquininhas, en cambio, menciona R$ 40.000 o R$ 80.000. Las ventas de VA/VR y Crediário no cuentan para la exención. Para confirmar cuál umbral se aplica, consulta el simulador de Getnet o confirma directamente con Getnet.

Fuentes:
https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference by stating the conflicting thresholds (R$ 60 mil on the Get Smart page and R$ 40 mil or R$ 80 mil on the general page) and recommending confirmation with the simulator or Getnet. It is fully supported by the evidence, including the note that VA/VR and Crediário do not count.

golden_repeat_items.question: What card machine model is registered on my account, and what are Getnet's published debit and 2x credit installment rates for that model?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The card machine registered to your account is **Get Clássica**.

Getnet’s published “from” rates for this model are **1.69% for debit** and **7.98% for credit in 2 installments (2x)**. They are listed as single rates for Mastercard, Visa, Elo, and Amex, for sales received in Get Conta. The offer is for new customers who are individuals, MEI, or companies with annual revenue up to R$3 million, subject to registration analysis; these are starting rates, not necessarily your account’s exact rates. Existing customers are directed to simulate their rates in the Getnet app.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the registered model Get Clássica and the published debit and 2x credit rates exactly. It also includes supported conditions from the evidence and does not add unsupported facts.

What are the two published payout plans in the Getnet FAQ (the 2-business-day plan and Receba conforme suas vendas) and their debit card rates?
And what are the 1x credit card rates on each of those two plans?
The Getnet FAQ lists:

- **2-business-day plan:** payout in 2 business days; debit rate **1.89%**.
- **“Receba conforme suas vendas”:** the FAQ does not specify a more detailed payout schedule; debit rate **1.95%**.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

golden_repeat_items.question: E como estão o sinal 4G e o Wi-Fi dela agora?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Agora, a telemetria da sua Get Smart (POS-GS-99812) mostra o 4G com a sessão de dados travada (“Dual-SIM 4G session stalled”) e o Wi‑Fi desativado (“Wi-Fi interface disabled”). O estado geral está OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT. As fontes consultadas não explicam esses estados individualmente nem informam como reativar o Wi‑Fi nos menus da Get Smart.

Como orientação de troubleshooting do runbook interno (não política oficial publicada), tente nesta ordem: reinicie a maquininha e aguarde o indicador de rede; se houver Wi‑Fi disponível, conecte-a à rede da loja; com o aparelho desligado, recoloque o chip e ligue-o novamente; depois, execute o teste de comunicação: tecla de função (F, # ou outra, conforme o modelo), 60, opção 2 (manutenção) e opção 1 (teste de comunicação). A FAQ explica a recolocação especificamente para o chip Algar, não para qualquer chip. Se continuar sem conexão tanto nos dados móveis quanto no Wi‑Fi após esses passos, peça um chamado com um especialista humano nesta conversa.

Sources: internal://support-runbook; https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/; https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on the 4G and Wi‑Fi states, but it adds troubleshooting steps and source claims that are not all supported by the evidence as stated. In particular, the final guidance to ask for a human in this conversation and some explanatory framing go beyond what is directly evidenced.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Por qué canales puedo abrirla y cuál es el número de WhatsApp de Getnet?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Si te refieres a abrir Get Conta, puedes hacerlo por el sitio web, WhatsApp o teléfono, al contratar un producto Getnet (maquininha, link de pagamento o Get Tap). El WhatsApp oficial para clientes es **(11) 97694-6815**. La información consultada no especifica el proceso para abrir una solicitud formal de soporte.

Fuentes: https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/ ; https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer correctly states the opening channels—site, WhatsApp, and phone—and gives the WhatsApp number 11 97694-6815, which matches the reference and evidence. It also appropriately notes that the formal support-case process is not specified, which is supported by the evidence.

assistant: Get Conta es la cuenta digital de Getnet. Permite recibir pagos en una misma cuenta, gestionar la operación, usar una tarjeta virtual gratuita y acceder al adelanto de cobros. Se gestiona desde la aplicación Getnet Brasil.

golden_repeat_items.question: Mi maquininha rechazó una venta hace poco con un error de transacción y sigue fallando. ¿Pueden revisar el diagnóstico y solicitar el reemplazo o resincronización del equipo?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
El operador rechazó el reemplazo inmediato: primero hay que conectar la maquininha a Wi‑Fi para intentar la resincronización remota de llaves. No se modificó el equipo ni se solicitó el reemplazo o la resincronización.

El diagnóstico de la Get Smart (POS-GS-99812) muestra `OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT` (sesión de datos 4G detenida) y `ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE / POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN` en la venta rechazada; el diagnóstico asocia `POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN` con una desincronización recurrente de las llaves del PIN-pad. Prueba estos pasos, en orden: reinicia la maquininha y espera el indicador de red; si hay Wi‑Fi disponible, conéctala a la red del local; apágala, recoloca la SIM y vuelve a encenderla; después ejecuta la prueba de comunicación: tecla de función (F, # u otra, según el modelo), 60, opción 2 (mantenimiento), opción 1 (prueba de comunicación). La guía no especifica los pasos de menú para configurar el Wi‑Fi ni para ejecutar la resincronización remota. Si continúa sin conexión tanto por datos móviles como por Wi‑Fi tras estos pasos, un especialista debe evaluar un cambio de chip o terminal.

Fuentes: internal://support-runbook; https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/; https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: La respuesta coincide con la referencia: no hubo aprobación de reemplazo inmediato y se pidió conectar la maquininha al Wi‑Fi antes de intentar la resincronización remota. Además, las acciones sugeridas y el estado OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT están respaldados por la evidencia disponible.

The Get Smart 5-in-1 combines a payment terminal, barcode reader, camera, fiscal-receipt printer, and integrated management system. golden_repeat_items.answer:
Las tasas «a partir de» para crédito en cuotas de Get Smart son: 4x: 8,96%; 10x: 11,90%; y 12x: 12,88%. La tarifa publicada es única para Mastercard, Visa, Elo y Amex, y aplica a ventas recibidas en Get Conta. La oferta no se puede combinar con otras negociaciones de Getnet ni de Banco Santander.

Fuentes: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly on the three rates and the non-combinability with other Getnet/Banco Santander negotiations. All claims are supported by the evidence, and it directly answers the merchant’s question.

golden_repeat_items.question: What are common reasons a bank triggers a chargeback on Getnet, and what happens with card-not-present sales even if the merchant proves the transaction?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet lists common chargeback reasons as goods not received or defective, the cardholder not recognizing the transaction, duplicate processing, a refund not being processed, or payment having been made by another means. A chargeback means the bank cancels the transaction and debits the merchant.

For card-not-present sales, Getnet’s FAQ says the sale can still be cancelled even if you prove the transaction. It does not explain why, what evidence standard applies, who ultimately bears liability, or what appeal or review process is available.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on all key points: it lists the same common chargeback reasons and correctly states that card-not-present sales can still be cancelled even if the merchant proves the transaction. All claims are supported by the evidence from the Getnet FAQ.

golden_repeat_items.question: A Get Conta oferece cartão virtual grátis e antecipação de recebíveis? Quais tipos de documento são aceitos no cadastro e em quais lojas de aplicativos o app Getnet Brasil está disponível?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Sim. A Get Conta oferece cartão virtual grátis e acesso à antecipação de recebíveis. As condições e taxas da antecipação não estão detalhadas em texto; podem ser consultadas simulando no app ou no Portal Minha Conta.

No cadastro, são usados CPF para pessoa física ou CNPJ para empresa. A página consultada não detalha outros documentos de identificação nem uma lista completa de documentos exigidos.

O app Getnet Brasil está disponível no Google Play e na App Store.

Fontes:
https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/
https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on all required points: free virtual card and receivables advance, CPF/CNPJ accepted, and app availability on Google Play and the App Store. All claims are supported by the evidence, including the note that conditions and rates are not detailed in text.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cuál es el horario límite diario y la tarifa exacta publicados por Getnet para la anticipación de ventas (antecipação)?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
Getnet no publica explícitamente un horario límite diario ni una tarifa exacta para la antecipação de ventas. Las tasas generales de otros planes que aparecen en la FAQ no corresponden a la tarifa de antecipação. Para conocer las condiciones aplicables a tu comercio, Getnet indica consultar una simulación en la app o en Portal Minha Conta, o confirmarlas con soporte.

Sources:
https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/
https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference: it states Getnet does not explicitly publish the daily cut-off time or exact fee, and gives the correct next steps (simulator in the app/Portal Minha Conta or support). The evidence supports these claims and the cited URLs.

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é o faturamento mensal mínimo necessário para ter isenção do aluguel da maquininha Get Clássica?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
As páginas públicas divergem: a página específica da Get Clássica informa isenção a partir de R$ 10 mil por mês, enquanto a página geral de maquininhas informa R$ 20 mil. Portanto, não consigo confirmar um único mínimo aplicável; confirme no simulador ou com a Getnet. A página específica informa aluguel de R$ 79,90/mês se o mínimo não for atingido e que vendas de Voucher (VA/VR) e Crediário não contam para a isenção.

Fontes: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/ ; https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the evidence and reference: it states the disagreement between R$ 10 mil and R$ 20 mil, advises confirming via simulator/Getnet, and includes the relevant rental and non-counting sales details. All claims are supported by the provided evidence and it directly answers the question.

golden_repeat_items.question: Qual é a razão social e o banco (nome, código e final da conta) cadastrados no meu perfil, e quais são as taxas de crédito parcelado em 6x e 9x na Get Clássica?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
A razão social cadastrada é **Bistrô Moinhos de Vento S.A.** Os dados bancários são **Banco Itaú**, código **341**, conta com final **04-2**.

Na Get Clássica, as taxas publicadas de crédito parcelado são **9,94% em 6x** e **11,41% em 9x**. São taxas “a partir de”, de taxa única para Mastercard, Visa, Elo e Amex. A oferta é para novos clientes (pessoa física, MEI e empresas com faturamento de até R$ 3 milhões por ano), sujeita à análise cadastral e com vendas recebidas pela Get Conta. Clientes Getnet atuais devem simular as taxas no app Getnet.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference exactly: it gives the registered business name, bank name/code/account ending, and the Get Clássica installment rates for 6x and 9x. All factual claims are supported by the evidence, including the published conditions and source URL.

golden_repeat_items.question: ¿Cuánto puede variar el plazo para recibir una venta hecha con ese medio, y cuántas claves permite para personas físicas y para empresas?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
El plazo para recibir una venta con Pix puede variar hasta un día corrido, según el modelo de Pix para el que seas elegible y la hora en que se apruebe la venta. Getnet también promociona el recibo «en segundos», pero el plazo no es único ni fijo.

Por cuenta, se permiten hasta 5 claves Pix para personas físicas y hasta 20 para empresas.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

judge.rationale: La respuesta coincide exactamente con la referencia: indica que el plazo puede variar hasta un día corrido y que hay hasta 5 claves para personas físicas y 20 para empresas. Todo lo dicho está respaldado por la evidencia sobre la página de Getnet.

golden_repeat_items.question: En el Link de Pagamento de Getnet, ¿cuánto cuesta al mes el plan Básico, cuántas transacciones con tarjeta incluye, cuánto cobra por transacción extra y se puede incluir el envío (frete) en el cobro?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
El plan Básico de Link de Pagamento cuesta R$ 28 al mes e incluye 60 transacciones con tarjeta mensuales. Cada transacción adicional cuesta R$ 0,50. Sí, puedes incluir el envío (frete) en el cobro: al crear el enlace, completa los datos del producto, del envío y las opciones de pago.

Fuente: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

judge.rationale: The answer exactly matches the reference: R$ 28/month, 60 card transactions included, R$ 0,50 per extra transaction, and shipping/frete can be included in the charge. The source URL is also supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.question: What does the Getnet FAQ recommend for charging the Get Smart battery (when to charge, for how long, and what to avoid), and what are the different ways to power a Getnet card machine on or off?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The Getnet FAQ recommends charging the Get Smart when its battery reaches 20%, for at least 3 consecutive hours, and avoiding letting it fully discharge.

Powering a Getnet card machine on or off depends on the model. The FAQ lists the green key, the up-arrow key, the plug, or holding the green/red key for 5 seconds. It does not say which method applies to each model or distinguish the precise on/off action for each one.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on all requested points: charge at 20%, for at least 3 consecutive hours, avoid full discharge, and lists the four power methods. All claims are supported by the evidence from the Getnet FAQ.

golden_repeat_items.question: With Getnet Crediário, who decides the maximum installment term and interest rate and approves the sale, how does the merchant get paid (timing and whether it arrives in a single lump sum), and do Crediário sales count toward the card machine rental waiver?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
The card issuer sets the maximum installment term and interest rate, and approves the transaction. Crediário can be paid in up to 48 installments; the card-machine simulation shows the interest. After capture, you receive the sale within up to 2 business days in a single payment, regardless of the installment count, net of the discount rate. Crediário sales do not count toward the card machine rental waiver.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the reference on all requested points: issuer decides the term/rate and approves, payment arrives up to 2 business days after capture in one lump sum, and Crediário sales do not count toward the rental waiver. All claims are supported by the evidence.

golden_repeat_items.answer:
Na Get Smart, o Modo Quiosque mantém a tela sempre ligada, é protegido por senha e executa um aplicativo por vez; é indicado para totens de autoatendimento. A informação publicada não detalha outros mecanismos de proteção além da senha.

golden_repeat_items.question: And how do I install it in the card machine?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
With the machine turned off, open the back cover and insert the Algar chip into the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2, with the metal side facing down. Close the cover, turn the machine on, and wait for the 2G or 3G network indicator; when it appears, the machine is ready. The FAQ does not specify which models are compatible, so check that your machine has a SIM1/SIM2 slot. The power-on method varies by model.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

judge.rationale: The answer matches the documented installation steps: power off, open back cover, insert into SIM1/SIM2 with metal side down, power on, and wait for the 2G/3G indicator. Its caveat that power-on varies by model is also supported by the evidence.

En la maquininha Get Smart, ¿qué pasa si paso dos ventas idénticas con la misma tarjeta y el mismo monto en menos de 5 minutos?
¿Y cómo cancelo en esa misma maquininha una venta de días anteriores?
En la Get Smart, si pasas dos ventas idénticas (misma tarjeta, marca e importe) en menos de 5 minutos, la segunda se cancela automáticamente; no se describe como un bloqueo de la tarjeta. Espera 5 minutos o usa un importe diferente para volver a intentarlo.

Fuente: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

golden_repeat_items.question: Mi maquininha rechazó una venta hace poco y sigue dando error. ¿Pueden revisar qué pasó con esa transacción rechazada y solicitar la corrección técnica necesaria?
golden_repeat_items.answer:
La venta TX-88410 por R$ 430,00 fue rechazada con ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE / POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN. El primer código indica un rechazo del emisor; junto con POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN, el diagnóstico señala una desincronización de las claves del PIN-pad de la Get Smart POS-GS-99812, que no puedes corregir por tu cuenta.

Se aprobó el rekey remoto del PIN-pad. Ya se creó la orden de servicio SO-F80F8E04 y quedó programada para ejecutarse dentro de las próximas 2 horas de hoy; el trabajo aún no se ha realizado. Mientras tanto, puedes vender con Pix o Link de Pagamento.

La orientación sobre estos códigos y el rekey procede de una guía interna de soporte, no de una política publicada de Getnet. Fuentes: internal://support-runbook; https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/; https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

items.answer:
Your Get Smart is reporting **OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT**, meaning its mobile-data session has stalled. Since reseating the SIM did not help, try restarting the terminal and waiting for its network indicator; if store Wi‑Fi is available, connect to it. Then run the communication test: press the function key (F, #, or the model-dependent key), enter **60**, choose **2 (manutenção)**, then **1 (teste de comunicação)**. The runbook’s sequence also specifies reseating the SIM with the terminal off and powering it back on; it is not confirmed whether your earlier reseat was done that way.

The restart and Wi‑Fi suggestions are internal troubleshooting guidance, not published Getnet policy. The Getnet FAQ describes the SIM procedure and communication test, but does not publish a general offline troubleshooting guide. If it remains offline on both mobile data and Wi‑Fi after these steps, a human specialist should handle a possible chip or terminal swap.

Separately, account diagnostics indicate a terminal key synchronization issue for which re-keying or a terminal swap requires human L2 approval before scheduling. That is distinct from the connectivity steps; nothing indicates that it has been approved or scheduled.

Sources: internal://support-runbook; https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

gate_rule: Golden metrics are gated over every run of --repeat N (ADR-0019): a floor holds when the mean of the runs reaches it and no single run is more than one item below it; a ceiling holds only if every run is within it. Every other suite runs once and is gated on that run.
